newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan PM says BOJ law revision an important task.
newsitem.headline: Japan PM says BOJ law revision an important task.

text.p: Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto said on Tuesday that revising a 54-year-old law governing the Bank of Japan is a very important task for his new cabinet.

"The reform of the Bank of Japan is a top priority for the Hashimoto cabinet, and we hope to implement the recommendations (by the panel) as soon as possible," Hashimoto said before the advisory panel meeting.
The private advisory panel set up by Hashimoto submitted a report on Tuesday recommending that the central bank be able to operate more autonomously.
